title: Translator Questions
description: A set of diagnostic questions for a translator to evaluate whether their translation expresses the pragmatic features identified in the original text. Generated from InterpreSure annotations and/or the biblical source. Questions should be answerable by looking at the translation alone — no source language knowledge required.

question.description: Plain-language question for the translator. Should not require source language knowledge.

importance.description: How important this question is for meaning preservation (1 = minor nuance, 10 = critical for the main point).

rationale.description: Why this question matters — the pragmatic feature at stake in plain terms.

annotation_topics.description: Which InterpreSure annotation topics this question draws from.

questions.description: The questions to present to the translator.
